mn10:4.9: In the same way, a mendicant breathing in heavily knows: ‘I’m breathing in heavily.’ Breathing out heavily, they know: ‘I’m breathing out heavily.’ Breathing in lightly, they know: ‘I’m breathing in lightly.’ Breathing out lightly, they know: ‘I’m breathing out lightly.’
mn10:4.10: They practice like this: ‘I’ll breathe in experiencing the whole body.’ They practice like this: ‘I’ll breathe out experiencing the whole body.’
mn10:4.11: They practice like this: ‘I’ll breathe in stilling the physical process.’ They practice like this: ‘I’ll breathe out stilling the physical process.’
